title: Shadowplay vs Turbo Cleave
summary: Their Enhancement Shaman holds two answers. Yours is a Shadow Priest with four, no escape and no interrupt — whoever gets reached first loses.

sections.title: Kill the Enhancement Shaman, and keep your Priest alive
sections.body: Counts, theirs: Warrior 8, Resto 3, Enhancement 2. Yours: Druid 5, Priest 4, Lock 4. Their Enhancement Shaman is the softest target on the floor. Your Shadow Priest is the second softest — four answers, no mobility, no interrupt — and a Warrior with Charge on 17s reaches him whenever he likes. This is a race, and you are the faster comp.

sections.title: Opener — both fears, on different targets

steps.note: 30s, on the Warrior. Different target, same global.
On whichever of them the fears did not reach.
120s. The slowest term; the cadence is this.
120s. The talent gives it to you AND your target.
30s. On the Resto, inside the window rather than before it.

sections.title: What the Enhancement Shaman answers with

steps.note: 120s, and then the list is empty.
17s. He is on your Priest whenever he chooses to be.
30s. Your Priest has no trinket-free way out of it.
40s and visible. Move before it lands.

sections.title: One correction to an earlier draft
sections.body: Shackle Horror is not control on a player — it only works on pets and NPCs, so it is not part of any chain here. Nothing in our data models who a spell can be cast on, so this is the class of error only a reader catches.
